tagline: Type a link or any text. A QR code appears.
description:
Type a link, a phone number, a message, or a contact, and a code appears on this screen.

The last code you made comes back the next time you open the app. A shared link can open the app already filled in. Press Invite in the GifOS bar to put the same code on everyone else's screen in a meeting.

Unofficial port of qrcodejs by davidshimjs. A general maker — not only Wi-Fi. For a fridge card with the network name and password, use WiFi Card instead.
